sources.title: Ciqikou Ancient Town: The Best Old Town to Visit in Chongqing
sources.content:
Located about 30 minutes (20km) drive from the center of Chongqing, Ciqikou Ancient Town was established in the Song Dynasty with over 1000 years of history. This destination served as an important dock for both water and land transportation and a major distribution center for porcelain.

The town follows a distinctive "one river, two streams, three mountains, and four streets" layout and is often called "Little Chongqing" due to its representation of the ancient city's character.

Recommended Walking Route: Exit 1 of subway station → Huangjueping Archway → Hanlin Yard → Baoshan Palace → Zhong's House → Yinglong Gate → Baolun Temple → Diaojiao Building Square

Key Sites:
Huangjueping Archway: Main entrance utilizing traditional Chinese stone carving techniques
Hanlin Yard: Ancient private school functioning as a teahouse
Baoshan Palace: Quadrangle courtyard with stage and teahouse
Zhong's House: One of the best-preserved Qing Dynasty residences in Ciqikou
Yinglong Gate: Historic dock along the Jialing River with distinctive stilt houses
Baolun Temple: A thousand-year-old temple in Ciqikou, ideal for sunset viewing
Diaojiao Building Square: Features Republic of China-era stilt houses

Dining: Spicy hot pot dishes such as Maoxuewang (duck blood in chili sauce), chicken giblets, hot and sour rice noodles. Signature items like Ciqikou Chen's twisted dough strips and salt and pepper peanuts.

Entertainment: Sichuan Opera's face-changing performance, traditional Sichuan storytelling in teahouses, seasonal temple fairs during Spring Festival.

Transportation: Line 1 rail transit has a dedicated station for Ciqikou, a few steps from the station to the ancient town's back streets.

sources.title: Ciqikou Ancient Town, Chongqing Ciqikou Old Town
sources.content:
Ciqikou Ancient Town is a great place to taste the Chongqing flavors and experience the old Chongqing. The ancient stone-paved roads create atmosphere where visitors feel they're stepping back in time. The site emphasizes authentic exploration away from crowded commercial areas to discover genuine historical architecture and local culture.

People often say: "If you weren't on Ciqikou, you weren't in Chongqing." The town has 12 streets in total, and most architectures were built in Ming or Qing architectural style with stone-paved roads.

Entrance to the town is free, and shops typically operate from 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM, with 3 to 5 hours recommended for visiting. Visit in the morning (before 10:00 AM) to avoid crowds or in the evening to enjoy the glowing red lanterns. Cobblestone streets are beautiful but uneven, so comfortable footwear is a must.

You can taste local flavors or order a cup of tea while watching folk performances like Sichuan Opera or Sichuan Qingyin. Getting there: Take Metro Line 1 to Ciqikou Station, exit at Exit 1. Also accessible by buses 202, 220, 237, 261, 467, 503, or 808.

sources.title: Ciqikou Ancient Town: Uncover the Old Chongqing
sources.content:
Ciqikou Ancient Town (磁器口古镇) is located in Shapingba District, Chongqing, and was originally built during the Song Dynasty (960-1279). Baolun Temple, built in the early Tang Dynasty and located at Baiyan Hill, is one of the most famous Buddhism temples in Chongqing.

The streets are lined with snack stalls featuring authentic Chongqing dishes such as Chongqing noodles, tofu pudding, and grilled skewers. Local crafts and souvenirs are available throughout the town.

sources.content: Ciqikou Ancient Town visitor reviews. A bustling ancient town with great street food and traditional architecture. The twisted dough strips (mahua) are a must-try. Can get very crowded on weekends. Best to visit early morning or evening. Free entry. Metro Line 1 takes you right there.

sources.title: 磁器口古镇_百度百科
sources.content:
磁器口古镇位于重庆市沙坪坝区，是国家AAAA级旅游景区。古镇始建于宋真宗咸平年间（998-1003年），原名白岩场，也称龙隐镇。总面积32.5万平方米，核心区域14.3万平方米。

历史演变：古镇因建文帝朱允炆曾在宝轮寺隐居而更名为龙隐镇。清初因瓷器产业兴盛，"瓷器口"后被改称"磁器口"。民国时期成为陪都重庆的重要商业枢纽，每天有300多艘载重10吨的货船进出码头。1958年后因交通方式改变而衰落，20世纪末开始旅游复兴。

建筑特色：古镇依山而建，采用"树枝状平面格局"，以磁器口正街和横街为骨架，42条巷道垂直发展。建筑保留传统民居风格，融合穿斗式和捆绑式结构。

主要景点：宝轮寺（重庆著名佛教寺院）、翰林院（清代私塾遗存）、宝善宫（道教宫观）、钟家院（清光绪时期四合院民居）、黄桷坪牌坊（古镇正门）。

特色美食与工艺：磁器口麻花、千张、椒盐花生、毛血旺等。传统手工艺有绘画、剪纸、木雕、瓷器工艺等。

文化活动：古镇书场定期讲述民间传说；传统节日活动；非遗表演常年展示。

旅游信息：全天开放，门票免费。交通：公交202/220/224/237/261/467/503/808/843路；轨道1/3/6/10号线。

荣誉：2006年获AAAA级景区；2015年列入首批中国历史文化街区；2021年入选国家级夜间文化消费集聚区；2022年成为首批国家级旅游休闲街区。

sources.title: 重庆磁器口古镇旅游攻略 - 知乎
sources.content: 重庆磁器口古镇旅游攻略。磁器口古镇位于重庆市沙坪坝区，比邻嘉陵江，自明、清时期以来一直是重要的水陆码头。古镇保留了大量明清建筑风格的传统民居，是体验老重庆生活方式的最佳去处。推荐品尝当地特色小吃如麻花、毛血旺等。
